choices.text: Let them talk. People say more to a listener than to a question.
Nod, and keep your own counsel.

nodes.text: I told you I did not wish to be behind my time; I dressed myself in the carriage, and descended at the viscount’s door.
Is your steward also a Nubian?
Morrel obeyed to the letter, to the great discomfiture of Barrois.
